_shared: Series-shared reference. Copied byte-identically into every deep-* skill's and deep-goal's references/ directory (the series standalone rule forbids cross-skill references). All copies must stay byte-identical; the series consistency sweep (scripts/check-shared.sh, maintainers only) verifies this. Rules for reading this file live in references/model-map.md. Keys starting with _ are documentation and are ignored.
_re_verify: Claude ids are host model ids. GPT ids are Codex model ids (codex debug models). The gpt-6.2-* ids are listed first for accounts that have them (RE-VERIFY per account); other accounts fall back to the next id.

ladder._order: Each list is the access-fallback order for that tier and family: current generation first, then previous generation.

stages._order: stages.<max>.<stage> = the tier a stage's lead runs at when --max=<max>.
